استشعرتا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْعَرَتَا (istašʕaratā) /is.taʃ.ʕa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
# اُسْتُشْعِرَتَا (ustušʕiratā) /us.tuʃ.ʕi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
